build_lm_transformer_model: build a language model transformer using LMTransformer with LMTransformerArgs for vocab size and sliding window
create_causal_mask: create a causal attention mask for xformers, sdpa, or flex_attention with optional sliding window support
compute_flops_per_token: compute the number of FLOPs per token given model params, layers, dim, and sequence length
parallelize_tensor_model: parallelize an LMTransformer model across tensor parallel workers using tp_parallelize with a device mesh
build_fsdp_plan: build an FSDP grouping plan for LMTransformer layers, embeddings, and output modules
